capabilities: Catalog vault files (PDFs, EPUBs, CBZ/CBR, Markdown, Word docs) as cover cards
Add categories, tags, descriptions, ratings, covers, and reading statuses to titles
Search, filter, and sort the collection by title, author, tag, or progress
Open files in Obsidian or the system default app and reveal them on disk
Export library metadata as a JSON backup
extras: Roadmap lists unimplemented ideas such as automatic PDF reading-progress tracking, ISBN cover lookup, and collections; metadata is stored in the plugin's data.json and clearing the catalog does not delete files.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer lists reading material as plain filenames, with no covers, reading statuses, or library-style browsing and filtering.
summary: Cover-grid library view that catalogs PDFs, EPUBs, comics, and documents already in the vault with tags, ratings, categories, and reading status.
